provenance.note: The P1 source files retain their original review fields and bytes. Founder acceptance is recorded by Issues #176/#183; no P1 file or calculation is changed or rerun.

backup.service_rule: covers any network/HP/tank shortfall without load shedding; exceedance is INVALID

time_and_service.fixture_generation: Use the byte-identical frozen 8,760-row UTC P1 paired_hours.csv.gz fixture. Zero-order hold hourly demand at the chosen internal solver step; no synthetic weather or demand is regenerated.

l2_geometry.topology: A stable synthetic waste-heat source -> A-C low-temperature closed loop -> C heat-pump/optional tank station -> C-B high-temperature closed loop -> B one seasonal aggregated building-service demand
l2_geometry.lengths_are: fictional single-trip trench lengths, not combined supply/return physical pipe length
l2_geometry.elevation_path: linear interpolation between fixed node elevations along each conceptual route; no unobserved intermediate high point
l2_geometry.coordinate_frame: arbitrary local right-handed XYZ, z up, m; no CRS, no field geometry

l2_fluid_properties.applicability: constant-property approximation across synthetic 12-68 degC envelope; temperature-dependent properties are not claimed; sensitivity/error is disclosed

saturation_pressure_rule.bound: conservative saturation-pressure upper bound 80,000 Pa over 0-90 degC synthetic domain
saturation_pressure_rule.reference: IAPWS-IF97 Region 4 saturation curve; coefficient/property implementation not installed
saturation_pressure_rule.safety_check: p_absolute - 80,000 Pa >= 50,000 Pa and p_absolute >= 120,000 Pa

l2_pipe_properties.wall_material: generic steel approximation, not a product specification
l2_pipe_properties.friction_model: Darcy-Weisbach; f=64/Re for Re<=2300; Swamee-Jain explicit turbulent approximation for Re>=4000; linear interpolation over 2300<Re<4000; zero friction at zero flow
l2_pipe_properties.insulation_model: lumped insulation/ground resistance represented by inherited P1 equivalent Uprime; no layer geometry or soil thermal diffusion

l2_flow_and_pumps.flow_control: load-following variable-speed circulation; required flow follows requested thermal transfer and frozen design ΔT; compute system friction and minor losses from actual flow, check pump curve capacity; if capacity insufficient, actual flow/service is limited and backup serves; never silently clamp demand
l2_flow_and_pumps.pump_curve: maximum head Δp=120000 Pa*(1-(Q/Qshut)^2), Qshut=3*Qdesign; available head checked against 25000 Pa inherited equipment allowance plus Darcy and local losses; variable-speed control may reduce speed, not exceed maximum curve
l2_flow_and_pumps.pressure_safety_rule: report absolute pressure along each supply/return profile; reject below 120 kPa or if pressure minus water saturation pressure at local temperature <50 kPa; calculate both local elevation pressure and full closed-loop static elevation sum

l2_heat_pump_and_tank.cop_rule: P1 Carnot-fraction rule with dynamic low-loop source return temperature and fixed 65 C heat-network supply plus 3 K approach; require 1<COP<=Carnot limit; HP output also bounded by 200 kW and source extraction by 150 kW

tank.thermal_model: single lumped usable-energy state; equivalent ΔT=25 K and water volume derived from frozen density/cp; no stratification claim

l2_heat_pump_and_tank.control: inherit P1 priority: HP serves current qualified demand, then charges tank; unmet demand first discharges tank where allowed, then common backup; no charging during P1 terminal restoration window; any deficit beyond backup is INVALID

initial_and_terminal_state.source_and_loop_water_mass: constant, same initial and terminal mass; no leakage or makeup
initial_and_terminal_state.pipe_and_wall_initialization: periodic annual state obtained by repeating the exact frozen demand year as warm-up; analyse one following cycle only when every cell's start/end temperature differs by <=0.01 K; warm-up outputs excluded from annual metrics
initial_and_terminal_state.terminal_acceptance: tank end exactly 0 kWh within 1e-7 kWh; per-cell fluid/wall periodic temperature delta <=0.01 K; otherwise INVALID and no layout ranking
initial_and_terminal_state.baseline_alignment: R0/R1 P1 baseline inventories remain zero; the L2 network cycle is periodic, so added pipe/water/wall/tank end-stock change is zero before comparing service/energy; no free initial heat

equations: quasi-steady 1D loop momentum with Darcy-Weisbach and local K losses plus rho*g*dz
math_and_solver.discretization: explicit finite-volume upwind advection coupled to lumped wall thermal capacities; source/sink node mixing by mass-weighted enthalpy; one-dimensional cells along each individual supply/return pipe
math_and_solver.stability: maximum design velocity 0.228 m/s; with the 40 m shortest segment split into two 20 m cells at dx<=25 m and dt=60 s, worst CFL=0.685; require CFL<=0.7 for explicit upwind stability; checked from frozen flow, diameter and mesh
math_and_solver.zero_flow: disable advection/friction, retain wall/ground thermal exchange and fixed inventories
math_and_solver.flow_reversal: orientation sign changes upwind boundary and route order; tested explicitly
math_and_solver.solver_choice: pure Python standard library only; no package installation or external simulator

scenarios.main: central: run exact P1 8760-hour matched demand for L/T; compare R0/R1/L/T with frozen P1 canonical annual service, energy, operation-carbon and cost records
preregistered_stress: cold_source: P1 source_C=25 C and carnot_fraction=0.34
long_pipes: P1 route overrides L=[1000,1800] m, T=[1600,3500] m, explicitly synthetic stress only
equal_geometry: L and T same A-C/C-B geometry, expect identical results
summer_winter: use frozen P1 monthly demand and source profile; no altered weather
failures: high point pressure below 120 kPa abs
long-distance synthetic delay and heat loss
scenarios.comparative_scope: report new L2 annual outputs next to immutable P1 reference; do not recalibrate, overwrite, or rerun P1

time_convergence: three levels dt=60/30/15 s at fixed dx=25 m
relative change <=0.5% for annual energy, pumping and qualified delivered heat; <=1.0% for peak metrics; delay difference <=15 s
space_convergence: three levels dx=50/25/12.5 m at fixed dt=30 s
relative change <=1.0% for annual energy, pumping and qualified delivered heat; <=2.0% for peak pressure and temperature
preregistered_acceptance_thresholds.independent_replay: independent script recomputes Darcy/hydrostatic anchors and annual energy/service from stored hourly rows; metrics agree to <=1e-6 relative or defined absolute floor
preregistered_acceptance_thresholds.ranking_rule: no recommendation if any quality gate fails; report synthetic conditional deltas, no probability interval, no environmental/health/receptor claim

resource_gate.gpu_memory: NOT_VERIFIED; not required because the frozen solver is single-process CPU Python and makes no GPU calls

resource_probe.measurement_note: Three runs of 10,000,000 non-physical updates: 1.2847 s maximum; measured memory for 8x76-cell state arrays and inventory 20,472 bytes (tracemalloc peak 288,754 bytes); representative 8,760-row profile output 1,094,129 bytes. 276,465,600 planned cell updates project to 71.04 s with 2x margin. This is a resource-only workload projection, not model performance or L2 output. During implementation stop before any full case if measured solver exceeds frozen 180 s/512 MiB/100 MiB budgets.

resource_gate.permissions: Python can execute and write only inside the authorized workspace; no install attempted and none required; computation is offline.

security_and_prohibitions.data: only byte-pinned SYNTHETIC P1 input fixture and newly declared SYNTHETIC parameters

decision_metrics.primary: annual purchased primary energy = electricity_kWh_e * grid_pe + fuel_kWh_LHV * fuel_pe
secondary: LCOH AUD/MWh using frozen P1 capex/lifetime/discount formula, recomputed only as a new L2 extension
decision_metrics.interpretation: Values below the preregistered delta are reported as below-decision-resolution. A ranking change is conditionally supported only if its sign changes beyond the applicable delta and every quality gate passes; no probabilities or external claims.

pre_run_gate.execution_order: Commit this manifest, gate document, SHA receipt, fixture copies, resource profile and deterministic validator before any formal L2 scenario output. After that commit, validate/implement analytic tests; measure the actual solver against budgets. If any check or budget fails, stop with GATE_BLOCKED/INVALID; do not run full annual L2 cases.
